title: Flatness and augmentation for the finite-free derived comparison
statement: For the specified finite-free short exact point resolution, every scheme pullback has a quasi-isomorphic augmentation, an independent-coefficient K-flat cone, and an invertible native localization tensor comparison.

proof.text: Use the three strictly smaller component theorems for the augmentation, K-flatness and native tensor comparison, then combine their conclusions.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact match; generic finite-module tensor lemmas only.
No existing declaration in source libraries.

lean.statement: theorem finiteFreeScalarDerivedComparison_flatness (D : ScalarSixPullbackData.{u}) {Λ Λ' : ScalarSixRing.{u}} (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') (S : ShortComplex (PointModules Λ)) (t : S.X₃ ≅ (Mod.comap a.hom.hom).obj (Mod.regular Λ'.X)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (r : ℕ) (e₁ : S.X₁ ≅ biproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ Mod.regular Λ.X)) (e₂ : S.X₂ ≅ biproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ Mod.regular Λ.X)) : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, QuasiIso (augmentation Λ S Z) ∧ CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence Λ.X Z).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (complex Λ S Z)) ∧ ∀ C : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X Z) ℤ, IsIso (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q (complex Λ S Z) C)
